description: REST API (Express) + demo seed data for all 7 scenarios (build-priority items 9-10 backend side). Exposes the decision engine and revenue metrics over HTTP, handles the Razorpay webhook endpoint with signature verification + idempotency, and seeds a SQLite DB with the 7 named scenarios that clearly distinguish genuine failure (RECOVER) from behavioural avoidance (RESTRICT/SUSPEND). Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: server/src/api/app.ts: Express app with JSON parsing (BUT the webhook route must access the RAW body for HMAC verification - use express.raw for that route). Routes: GET /api/health, GET /api/dashboard (revenue-at-risk + risk distribution + recent recovery events), GET /api/customers (list with score/band/decision/access state), GET /api/customers/:id (subscription, payment history, behavioural timeline, risk score, evidence, recommended action, access state), POST /api/customers/:id/explain (returns LLM-or-fallback explanation + drafted recovery message), POST /api/customers/:id/review (merchant approve/appeal controls: approve blacklist recommendation, reinstate access - writes audit_log), POST /api/webhooks/razorpay (verify signature on raw body, dedupe via x-razorpay-event-id, ingest event, re-evaluate customer, persist decision + audit). Validate inputs with zod. Central error handler.
server/src/api/server.ts: bootstrap that runs migrations, wires config-selected adapters, starts listening on PORT.

server/src/seed/scenarios.ts + seed.ts: build and insert the 7 scenarios with realistic timelines: (1) Normal successful customer -> ACTIVE/RECOVER-not-needed low risk; (2) Genuine temporary failure -> recovered (transient failure then success -> RECOVER, access restored); (3) Recoverable needing alternate intervention (repeated insufficient_funds -> RECOVER with alternate_payment_method/upi_payment_link); (4) Repeated autopay cancellation near renewal -> RESTRICT; (5) Cancellation/resubscription cycling -> high risk INTERVENE/RESTRICT; (6) Repeated unpaid usage/value extraction -> SUSPEND + BLACKLIST_RECOMMENDED; (7) Legitimate repeated failures (e.g. expired card, bank outage, then genuine retries) -> RECOVER, explicitly NOT blacklist. Each scenario must produce the intended outcome deterministically through the engine.
Wire root/server npm scripts: `seed` (migrate + insert scenarios), `dev` (start server, e.g. via tsx watch), `start` (node dist).

Manual sanity: after seed + dev, GET /api/customers should return 7 customers whose decisions match the intended outcomes, and scenario 6 should carry a blacklist RECOMMENDATION flag while scenario 7 must NOT.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run seed` populates the SQLite DB with exactly the 7 named scenarios
GET /api/dashboard returns revenue metrics and risk distribution
GET /api/customers/:id returns full explainable detail (evidence, recommended action, access state, timeline)
Webhook endpoint rejects requests with invalid signature (401) and dedupes repeated x-razorpay-event-id
Scenario 2/3/7 resolve to RECOVER; scenario 4/5 to RESTRICT/INTERVENE; scenario 6 to SUSPEND with blacklist recommendation; scenario 7 is RECOVER and NOT blacklist
verification: Run `npm run seed` then start the server and curl GET /api/customers + GET /api/dashboard to confirm the 7 scenarios and metrics; confirm scenario outcomes match intended mapping
curl the webhook with a bad signature and confirm 401; with a valid HMAC signature confirm 200 and idempotent handling on replay
findings:
IMPLEMENTED: server/src/api/app.ts (Express factory with DI: repo + paymentAdapter + llmAdapter; webhook route registered BEFORE express.json using express.raw so HMAC runs on exact raw bytes), server/src/api/server.ts (bootstrap: openDatabase->Repository->config-selected adapters->createApp->listen on PORT), server/src/seed/scenarios.ts (7 scenarios as data with per-scenario expected outcomes), server/src/seed/seed.ts (idempotent reset+seed; runs the REAL engine per scenario, persists decision+access transition+audit, asserts outcome==expected and exits non-zero on mismatch). Routes: GET /api/health, GET /api/dashboard, GET /api/customers, GET /api/customers/:id, POST /api/customers/:id/explain, POST /api/customers/:id/review, POST /api/webhooks/razorpay. zod validation + central error handler (401 bad webhook sig, 400 zod, mapped HttpError, 500 fallback).

RUNTIME CONSTRAINT RESOLVED: the raw-.ts npm scripts (dev/seed/migrate) run via `node --experimental-strip-types`, which does NOT rewrite the existing sources' NodeNext `.js`-extension relative imports back to `.ts` (confirmed: `npm run migrate` failed pre-change with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for config.js). Rather than churn every existing import, added a tiny ESM resolution hook: server/src/ts-resolve-hook.mjs (maps ./x.js -> ./x.ts when the .ts exists) registered by server/src/register-ts.mjs, wired into dev/seed/migrate via `--import ./src/register-ts.mjs`. This has ZERO effect on the tsc/dist build. Verified: `npm run migrate`, `npm run seed`, and `npm run dev` (raw ts) all run; `npm run start` runs the compiled dist. No parameter-property constructors used (Repository already avoids them; app/server use plain functions).

SCENARIO OUTCOMES (deterministic, verified through the real engine via `npm run seed`): 1 normal_success -> RECOVER/ACTIVE risk 0; 2 genuine_temporary_failure -> RECOVER/ACTIVE (transient GATEWAY_ERROR then success restores access); 3 recoverable_alternate_intervention -> RECOVER/RECOVERY risk 7.4 with recommendedAction upi_payment_link (insufficient_funds x2 + accessHistory {attemptedActions:[delayed_retry], failedRetries:1} escalates next-best action to UPI, no restriction); 4 autopay_cancel_near_renewal -> RESTRICT/RESTRICTED (renewal_avoidance@0.75 strong avoidance); 5 cancel_resubscribe_cycling -> RESTRICT/RESTRICTED risk 51.3 medium (near-renewal cancel+resubscribe cycling => renewal_avoidance@0.75, NO grace usage so not SUSPEND); 6 grace_value_extraction -> SUSPEND/SUSPENDED risk 100 with blacklistRecommended=true (grace_period_value_extraction@1 + cancel_use_resubscribe_loop@1, score>=80 & maxAvoidance>=0.8 => highConfidenceAbuse); 7 legitimate_repeated_failures -> RECOVER/ACTIVE, blacklistRecommended=false (varied GENUINE codes CARD_EXPIRED then ISSUER_NOT_AVAILABLE then success; never escalates to suspicious because different codes avoid the >=3 same-transient-code escalation). Scenario 6 carries blacklist RECOMMENDATION, scenario 7 explicitly does NOT. NOTE: engine rules were NOT weakened; only scenario timelines/metadata were tuned (scenario 5 originally produced RECOVER at risk 31 with only non-avoidance cancellation_cycling; adding daysToRenewal to its cancellations produced the intended renewal_avoidance strong-avoidance => RESTRICT).

VERIFICATION EVIDENCE:
- `npm run build` (tsc) passes (fixed a TS4058 by giving buildServer an explicit BuiltServer return type importing DB/AppConfig/Express).
- `npm run seed` -> 'Seeded 7 scenarios (7 matched expectations)'; all 7 print OK with the outcomes above.
- Server curl checks (PORT set, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_demo): GET /api/health -> {status:ok,paymentMode:simulation,llm:deterministic}; GET /api/customers -> 7 customers with the score/band/decision/access/blacklist above; GET /api/dashboard -> revenue {total 349300, recovered 149700, atRisk 149700, pending 49900, lost 49900, recoveryRate 0.43}, riskDistribution {low:5,medium:1,high:1}, highestPriorityCustomers, predictedFailures, recentDecisions/recentRecoveries; GET /api/customers/cust_extraction -> full detail (subscription, paymentHistory, behaviouralTimeline, merged timeline, riskScore 100, evidence[], recommendedAction, accessState SUSPENDED); POST /explain -> deterministic explanation + drafted recovery message; POST /review approve_blacklist -> audit written, accessState SUSPENDED->BLACKLIST_RECOMMENDED.
- Webhook: bad signature -> HTTP 401 {error:Invalid or missing webhook signature}; valid HMAC-SHA256(raw body, secret) in x-razorpay-signature -> HTTP 200 {status:processed,event:payment.failed,outcome:RECOVER}; replay same x-razorpay-event-id -> HTTP 200 {status:duplicate} (idempotent via processed_webhooks).
- `npm test` currently fails with 'No test files found' because the test suite is FEAT-004 (not this feature's scope); no test dir exists yet, so this is expected and pre-existing, not a regression.

SCRIPTS: server/package.json dev -> node --watch --experimental-strip-types --import ./src/register-ts.mjs src/api/server.ts; start -> node dist/api/server.js; migrate & seed use the same --import hook. Root package.json adds `start`. Data DB (server/data/app.db under the workspace cwd of the server workspace) is gitignored (matched by *.db).
